scenes.title: The Album
scenes.headline: UK breakthrough
scenes.supportingCopy: The song appears on the album "Direct Hits" (2013). It was released on February 13, 2007, as the third single from their second studio album, Sam's Town (2006). Direct Hits is a greatest hits album by American rock band the Killers. The album includes tracks from the band's first four studio albums and features two new tracks—"Shot at the Night" and "Just Another Girl", produced by Anthony Gonzalez of M83 and Stuart Price, respectively. Artist: Killers · Title: Read My Mind · Album: The Killers - Sam's Town · Year: 2006 · Genre: New Wave · Path: MEDIA/VIDEO/2000's/Killers - Read My The Killers have released seven studio albums, each of which topped the UK Albums Chart: Hot Fuss (2004), Sam's Town (2006), Day & Age (2008), Battle Born (2012), Wonderful Wonderful (2017), Imploding the Mirage (2020), and Pressure Machine (2021).
